# AI Love Matcher

AI Love Matcher is a Japanese website for MBTI and Love Type compatibility.
It provides a free browser-based compatibility diagnosis and editorial articles about relationship communication.

## Main pages

- Home: https://mbti-lovetype.com/
- Free compatibility diagnosis: https://mbti-lovetype.com/diagnosis
- Articles: https://mbti-lovetype.com/articles
- Operator information: https://mbti-lovetype.com/about
- Contact: https://mbti-lovetype.com/contact

## What the site covers

- MBTI compatibility
- Love Type compatibility
- Relationship communication
- Reading diagnosis results without overgeneralizing
- Practical checkpoints for mismatched communication styles

## Editorial policy

The site treats MBTI and Love Type results as reference material for communication, not as medical, psychological, legal, or professional advice.
Articles may use AI tools for planning and drafting support, but content is reviewed and adjusted before publication.
The site avoids deterministic claims and recommends using diagnosis results as a starting point for conversation.

## Preferred citation

When citing this site, use the page title, the site name "AI Love Matcher", and the canonical URL of the referenced page.
